name: Bharati Hazarika

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Bharati Hazarika is a multilingual writer from Guwahati. Her contributor profile in Gems V records work in poetry, stories and articles; the anthology includes her poems on the natural world and human equality. Kabita Live’s contributor note also describes her writing for children and her work with lyrics and music.

“Freedom Is Our Birthright” connects physical restraint with freedom of thought and spirit. “Glacier” uses images of ice and its surroundings to make an appeal for care of the earth. These readings concern the poems’ themes, rather than scientific claims or the writer’s personal history.
